title: Geometric and perfect-object data for an open stage
statement: For any open B of Y and perfect P,Q, construct localized derived categories on B.toScheme and prove that the specified exact restriction of Q and the shift by -n of the exact restriction of P are perfect. The global derived categories and localized categories on Y are supplied; the open categories are constructed by transport along Modules.overEquiv. [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex, def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data].

proof.text: For each open T of B.toScheme, transport the supplied localization on T.toScheme along the exact Modules.overEquiv T: use the mapped complex equivalence followed by Q as localization. This is a fully proved private helper copied from PerfectRestrictionClassesSmall; no unproved existence theorem supplies data.

Exact restriction is derived pullback by left-derived uniqueness and restrictFunctorIsoPullback. Apply derivedPullback_preserve_perfect to P and Q and transport the resulting local models across the comparison. Shift P′ by -n using the same local retract models with translated finite bounds.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09UA; proved using derivedPullback_preserve_perfect, exact derived uniqueness, and explicit localization transport

theorem perfect_hom_open_stage_data
    (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ B : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over B))]
    (B : Y.Opens) (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y)
    (hP : Y.IsPerfect P) (hQ : Y.IsPerfect Q) (n : ℤ) :
    ∃ hcat : ∀ T : B.toScheme.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w}
        (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings B.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over T)),
      let := hcat
      B.toScheme.IsPerfect (((schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).obj P)⟦-n⟧) ∧
      B.toScheme.IsPerfect ((schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).obj Q)
